notablePrerequisites: Efreet Flamepainter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Efreet Flamepainter.
Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Rise of the Eldrazi from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rise of the Eldrazi, destroying a permanent, causing a player to draw four cards, and causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Rise of the Eldrazi from exile into your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.
